kpis.metric: Recurring Revenue as % of Total Revenue

payload._note: SPSC is a SaaS provider of cloud-based supply chain management services. The company reports 44,800 recurring revenue customers as of 2023-12-31, with 94% of total revenue coming from recurring sources. Revenue grew from $450.9M (2022) to $536.9M (2023), representing 19.1% YoY growth. This marks their 92nd consecutive quarter of revenue growth. The filing explicitly states that the largest customer represented less than 1% of total revenues for all periods disclosed (2023, 2022, 2021), indicating strong revenue diversification. The company does not disclose traditional SaaS metrics like NRR/GRR, ARR, or customer count by segment. No individual customers are named. The filing mentions 120,000 total organizations have used their products to date (cumulative lifetime figure including both recurring and non-recurring customers). The company operates on monthly recurring contracts, though most contracts allow 30-90 day cancellation notice, indicating relatively short contract lock-in despite high recurring revenue percentage.
